text: Refined the public streaming contract after type-discipline review: ResamplingSink now receives one canonical output-linear index plus value and validity weight. This removes five fixed coordinate slots, placeholder zeros for absent axes, and the application hot-loop coordinate tuple. Estimator decodes its rank-three fixed index with primitive arithmetic; volume/slice application maps the local linear index directly into the final rank-four builder. The prior green receipts predate this API refinement and must be rerun before closure.
